verdict.rationale: An AI-assisted devtool that analyzes the component tree is a fair thing to ask of a UI framework's ecosystem, so this axis applies. However, nothing in the evidence shows Vue shipping such a tool. The Tooling Guide appears only as a title, the llms.txt file is LLM-readable documentation rather than a devtool, and the 'compiler-optimized rendering' claim is not an AI tool that suggests optimizations.
